interfaces.name: ankle_bearing
interfaces.what: Ø15.0 x 2.3 pocket behind a Ø14.0 window, Ø16 x 0.5 45-deg lead-in at the inner face x -35.3 — the outer-race seat of the 15x10x3 ankle bearing; mirror of the left bracket's seat about x=0
interfaces.source: MEASURED off ankle_left.stl (this part is its true mirror: p95 0.000 mm, max 0.0087 mm, out/measure/ankle/mirror-test.json), 2026-09-01

interfaces.name: ankle_horn
interfaces.what: inner face of the horn wall: Ø5.0 through at the axis, 4 x Ø2.2 at (dy,dz) = (0,±6) and (±6,0) with Ø4.4 counterbores from x -66.5 out — the XL330 horn bolt diamond, mirrored

interfaces.name: foot_screw
interfaces.what: Ø2.2 vertical through the 2.5 mm plate with a Ø4.4 x 1.0 counterbore from the plate top — the single M2 that hangs the foot

interfaces.name: foot_blocks
interfaces.what: the two +y blocks that index the foot: prisms x -39.1000..-34.1000 and -65.9000..-60.9000 (5.0000 mm each, pair pitch 26.8000 mm), each a pair of 1.5000 mm ribs at y 31.6630..33.1630 and 34.1630..35.6630 with a 1.0000 mm gap (envelope 4.0000 mm), standing z -21.3420..-15.2810 (inner rib, 6.0610 mm) and -21.3420..-13.3420 (outer rib, 8.0000 mm). They drop through the foot's two THROUGH-pockets (5.2000 x 4.2000 mm) at 0.1000 mm clearance per side on both axes while the Ø32.6000 (R16.3018-16.3058) under-hull lands on the foot's two R16.3 end ledges. NOTHING SNAPS: the pockets are open top to bottom, no undercut or barb exists on either side, and a 0.1000 mm clearance cannot snap — the foot is retained by the single M2 at (x -50.0000, y 4.5020) on connection:threaded-m2. See connection:snap-fit-ankle-blocks.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh by cecad.meshfeatures.intervals ray-cast calipers (block x spans at y 31.8/32.4/33.0/34.5/35.5 z -20; rib y spans at z -21.3/-20.5/-20.0 x |x| 36.5; block z spans at (|x| 36.5 and 63.5, y 32.4 and 34.9)) and cecad.meshslice circle fits of the under-hull at |x| 40 and 60 (R16.3058 residual mean 0.00432; R16.3018 residual mean 0.00396); frozen in ce-connections/snap-fit-ankle-blocks/iterations/v0.0.1/evidence/ankle-blocks-fit.json, 2026-09-02 (lane T)

interfaces.name: foot_snap_plate
interfaces.what: the 36.5000 mm-wide plate the foot's barbed fingers snap over: y 0.1632..36.6632 at z -15.5000..-15.0000, stepping down to 33.7000 mm (y 1.5630..35.2630) above z -14.5000. It sits in the foot's 36.7000 mm pocket at 0.1000 mm per side, clears the 34.7000 mm barb land by 0.5000 mm per side where it is narrow, and needs 0.9000 mm of deflection per finger to pass it where it is wide; the barbs then stand 0.9000 mm over its shoulder. This is the joint that stops the foot lifting off — connection:snap-fit-ankle-blocks explicitly does not (its pockets are open in z) and the single M2 at (-50.0000, 4.5020) secures. See connection:snap-fit-roller-axle.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's foot and ankle meshes by cecad.meshfeatures.intervals ray-cast calipers (finger inner faces along y at |x| 50 for z -12.3500 .. -15.0000; finger x span along x at y 0.0 and 37.0; ankle plate width along y at |x| 50 for z -13.6000 .. -15.5000) plus the mesh inventory of all four of Pollen's MJCF files; frozen in ce-connections/snap-fit-roller-axle/iterations/v0.0.1/evidence/roller-slot-fit.json, 2026-09-02 (lane T)
